content: Dɑfidi u yɑkurɑ u doonɑ sɑɑ Rɑmɑn wɔɔ berɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Nɑyɔtun di, u dɑ u Yonɑtɑm deemɑ. U nɛɛ, mbɑ nɑ kuɑ. Mbɑ nɛn torɑru. Nɡe tɑɑrɛ mbɑ nɑ wunɛn tundo kuɑ u kɑ kĩ u mɑn ɡo.

Yonɑtɑm u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, su ku wɑ mɛ! A ǹ ɡbimɔ. Nɛn tundo u ku rɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu ko u kun mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ, bɑɑ ǹ n ɡɑ̃ɑ piiminun nɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, u ǹ yenin bweseru mɔ̀ u kun mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Gɑri yi, yi ǹ sɑ̃ɑ mɛ.

Dɑfidi u nɛɛ, kɑm kɑm mɛyɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ. Adɑmɑ wunɛn tundo u ǹ dere ɑ yi nɔ, domi u yɛ̃ mɑ ɑ mɑn kĩ too. U ǹ mɑɑ kĩ wunɛn nukuru tu sɑnkirɑ. Sere kɑ wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru kɑ mɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru, nɑɑ dɑbusɑ teerɑ tɑ mɑn kɑrɑnɛ kɑ ɡɔɔ.
Mɑ Yonɑtɑm u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ye ɑ kĩ kpuro, ɑ ɡeruo. Kon nun ye kuɑ.
Dɑfidi u nɛɛ, wee siɑrɑ suru kpɑo u koo yɑri. Nɑ ǹ kon mɑɑ ko nɑ kun de sunɔn mi su di sɑnnu. Adɑmɑ ɑ de n dɑ n kuke yɑkɑsɔ sere n kɑ ko sin teerun yokɑ.
Wunɛn tundo ù n bikiɑ mɑnɑ nɑ wɑ̃, ɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɔ mɑ nɑ nun kɑnɑ n kɑ dɑ nɛn wuu Bɛtelehɛmuɔ. Domi nɛn yɛnuɡibu kpuro bɑ ben wɔ̃ɔ kɑ wɔ̃ɔn yɑ̃kuru mɔ̀ mi.
Ù n nɛɛ, n wɑ̃, nɛ wunɛn bɔ̃ɔ, nɑ ɑlɑfiɑ wɑwɑ. Adɑmɑ ù n mɔru bɑrɑ, ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ kɔ̃sɑ u bwisikumɔ nɛn sɔ̃.

Adɑmɑ wunɛ, ɑ mɑn kĩru sɔ̃ɔsio, domi ɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ mɑ kɑɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɛn bɔrɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Nɑ̀ n tɑɑrɛ ɡɑɑ mɔ, ɑ mɑn ɡoowo wunɛn tii. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ kɑɑ kɑ mɑn dɑ wunɛn tundon mi u kɑ mɑn ɡo.
Yonɑtɑm u nɛɛ, ɑ ku yenin bweseru bwisiku. Nɑ̀ n ɡiɑ mɑ nɛn tundo u kĩ u nun kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ, kon nun sɔ̃.
Dɑfidi u bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wunɛn tundo ù n kɑ nun mɔru wisɑ, wɑrɑ koo mɑn sɔ̃.
Yonɑtɑm u nɛɛ, ɑ nɑ su dɑ yɑkɑsɔ. Mɑ be yiru bɑ yɑrɑ bɑ dɑ yɑkɑsɔ.

Mɑ Yonɑtɑm u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sere kɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinnin wɑ̃ɑru, siɑ ɑmɑdɑɑre, ǹ kun mɛ sin teeru, kon nɛn tundon lɑɑkɑri mɛɛri. Ù n ɡeɑ bwisikumɔn nɑ wunɛn sɔ̃, kon nun ɡoo ɡɔriɑmɑ u nun sɔ̃.
Adɑmɑ ù n kĩ u nun kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ, kon nun nɔɔsiɑ kpɑ n de ɑ doonɑ kɑ bwɛ̃ɛ dorɑ. Nɑ̀ kun kue mɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn yen dibu kɔsiɑ. Kpɑ u nun yɔ̃re nɡe mɛ u nɛn tundo yɔ̃re.
Adɑmɑ sɑɑ ye nɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ kpuro, ɑ mɑn kĩru sɔ̃ɔsio tèn bweseru Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ win tɔmbu sɔ̃ɔsi, kpɑ bu ku rɑɑ mɑn ɡo. Nɑ̀ n mɑɑ ɡu,
kpɑ ɑ nɛn yɛnuɡibu kĩru sɔ̃ɔsi, bɑɑ sɑnɑm mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑ kpuro bɑ ɡbisukɑ bɑ kpɑ.
Mɑ u kɑ Dɑfidi ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ win yɛnuɡibun sɔ̃ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u Dɑfidin yibɛrɛbɑ ben dibu kɔsie.
Yen biru Yonɑtɑm u derɑ Dɑfidi u win nɔɔ mwɛɛru sire kĩrun sɔ̃ domi u nùn kĩɑ nɡe win tiin hunde.
Mɑ u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, siɑrɑ suru kpɑo koo yɑri. Bɑ koo bikiɑ, mɑnɑ ɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Domi bɑ̀ n dimɔ, bɑ koo wɑ mɑ ɑ ǹ wɑ̃ɑ wunɛn sin yerɔ.
Sin teerun yokɑ, ɑ doo mi ɑ rɑɑ kukuɑ sɑnɑm mɛ wɑhɑlɑ ye, yɑ toruɑ. Kpɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ kpee te bɑ mɔ̀ Esɛlin ɡɑ̃ɑrɔ.
Kon sɛ̃ɛnu itɑ to kpee ten berɑ ɡiɑ kpɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe yĩreru ɡɑrɑ nɑ toosimɔ.

Yen biru kon bii ɡɔri u dɑ u sɛ̃ɛ ni kɑsumɑ. Nɑ̀ n nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, u mɛɛrio, wee sɛ̃ɛ ni, nu wɑ̃ɑ win biruɔ, u nu tɑmɑ, ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ yɑrimɑ kɑ bɔri yɛndu. Domi sere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru, kɑri mɑɑ sɑri.
Adɑmɑ nɑ̀ n bii wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, wee sɛ̃ɛ ni, nu wɑ̃ɑ win wuswɑɑɔ, ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u kĩ ɑ doonɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ doonɔ.
Gɑri yi sɑ mɑɑ bɔkuɑ nɛ kɑ wunɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn seedɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u dɑ u kukuɑ yɑkɑsɔ. Ye suru kpɑo u yɑrɑ, sunɔ u nɑ u kɑ yen tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di.
Mɑ u sinɑ win ɑyerɔ ɡɑnɑn bɔkuɔ, Abinɛɛ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ win bɔkuɔ, mɑ Yonɑtɑm u sinɑ ben wuswɑɑɔ, ɑdɑmɑ Dɑfidin sin yerɔ ɡoo sɑri.
Tɔ̃ɔ te sɔɔ, Sɔɔlu kun ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡeruɑ, domi u tɑmɑɑ, u disi mɔwɑ. Yiyɑ yi ko n nùn yinɑri.
Adɑmɑ yen sisiru, surun sɔ̃ɔ yiruse, ɡoo sɑri kpɑm Dɑfidin sin yerɔ. Mɑ Sɔɔlu u win bii Yonɑtɑm bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ Isɑin bii u ǹ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru nɛ sɑɑ ɡĩɑn di.
Mɑ Yonɑtɑm u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, Dɑfidi u mɑn suuru kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, n de u dɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ,
domi miyɑ bɑ yɑ̃kuru ɡɑru mɔ, mɑ win mɔɔ u nùn sokusiɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u nɛɛ, ù n nɛn kĩi ɡeeru wɑ, n nùn yɔllɑ kuo u dɑ u win mɑɑbu wɑ. Yerɑ n derɑ u ǹ nɛ u kɑ nun di.
Mɑ Sɔɔlu kɑ Yonɑtɑm mɔru kuɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bii seeɡe wunɛ! Nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn mɛron sekurɑ nɔɔ tiɑ ye ɑ kɑ Isɑin bii sɑ̃ɑ mi.
Domi ù n wɑ̃ɑ wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ, ɑ ǹ mɑɑ bɑndu dimɔ tem mɛ sɔɔ. A ǹ kɑɑ n mɑɑ bɔri yɛndu mɔ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ ɡɔrio bu nùn mwɑɑmɑ, domi n weenɛwɑ bu nùn ɡo.
Mɑ Yonɑtɑm u win tundo bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ u koo ɡbi. Mbɑ u kuɑ.
Yerɑ Sɔɔlu u win yɑɑsɑ fĩɑ u kɑ Yonɑtɑm sɔku, mɑ Yonɑtɑm u ɡiɑ mɑ win tundo u sɔɔru kpɑ u kɑ Dɑfidi ɡo.
Yerɑ u seewɑ dii yerun min di kɑ mɔru. U ǹ mɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yirusen tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ te di. Win nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ ɡem ɡem Dɑfidin sɔ̃. Domi win tundo u nùn bɛɛrɛ sɑri kom kuɑ.
Ye n kuɑ sisiru bururu, Yonɑtɑm u dɑ yɑm mi bɑ rɑɑ yinnɑ yeru kuɑnɑ, wi kɑ Dɑfidi. Mɑ bii tɔn durɔbu ɡɑɡu ɡɑ nùn swĩi.
Mɑ u bii wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ dukɑ doo ɑ sɛ̃ɛ ni kon to mi kɑsumɑ. Ye bii wi, u dukɑ dɔɔ, yerɑ Yonɑtɑm u sɛ̃u tobɑ ɡɑ nùn sɑrɑri.
Sɑɑ ye bii wi, u turɑ deedeeru mi sɛ̃u ɡe, ɡɑ dɑ, yerɑ Yonɑtɑm u kpɑm ɡbɑ̃rɑ u nɛɛ, ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ,
ɑ dukɑ doo, ɑ ku yɔ̃rɑ, ɑ wɑsi suo. Mɑ bii wi, u dɑ u sɛ̃u ɡe dɔbɑmɑ u kɑ nɑ win yinnin mi.
Adɑmɑ u ǹ yɛ̃ ɑsiri ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi. Yonɑtɑm kɑ Dɑfidi tɔnɑwɑ bɑ ye yɛ̃ɛsinɛ.
Mɑ Yonɑtɑm u win tɑbu yɑ̃nu suɑ u bii wi wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, ɑ kɑ wuro yɛnuɔ.

Sɑɑ ye bii wi, u doonɑ mɑ Dɑfidi u yɑrimɑ sɑɑ kpee ten ɡɑ̃ɑrun di sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ. Yerɑ u Yonɑtɑm kpunɑ nɔn itɑ u wiru tem ɡirɑri. Mɑ u seewɑ bɑ bɔkɑsinɑ bɑ swĩsi be kpuro. Adɑmɑ Dɑfidiɡiiyɑ yi kerɑ.

Mɑ Yonɑtɑm u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo kɑ ɑlɑfiɑ, kpɑ ɑ n yɑɑye nɡe mɛ nɛ kɑ wunɛ sɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ sɑ bɔ̃ruɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru sɑ nɛɛ, u n wɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ kɑ mɑɑ bɛsɛn bibu sɔɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
